headline: Indian Bond Yields Rise as Brent Surpasses $95 and Inflation Risks Mount
summary: Indian benchmark bond yields climbed, with the 6.94% 2036 bond yield reaching 7.2125%, as rising oil prices and food inflation risks weighed on fixed-income sentiment.
why: Sovereign bond yields rise when bond prices fall, typically driven by inflationary pressures that erode fixed-income returns and prompt expectations of tighter monetary policy.

impacts.name: India 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Higher crude oil prices and inflation risks increase sovereign borrowing costs.
